about me

Corey Sherrard Jr (b. 1996) engineers a developing system for composing songs and generating objects that respond to the deficit of black radical propaganda within a world culture. He graduated from the University of Houston with a BS in Digital Media. Sherrard has exhibited at Sanman Studios, Sabine Street Studios, Houston Endowment, Cleve Carney Museum of Art, and the George Washington Carver Museum and Cultural Center. He is a 2023 Jones Artist Awardee and an alumni of the School for Poetic Computation. Under the pseudonym Yaajé, he releases music solo and collaboratively with his band Essex Moor.
